qmd-autosearch 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。模型在知识库目录执行 grep/glob 搜索时自动补充 QMD 语义检索：零依赖 DSH 插件，异步注入下一步上下文，无需手动调用。

posts.en:
qmd-autosearch is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Auto-supplement QMD semantic search when the model greps/globs a knowledge-base directory: zero-dependency DSH plugin, async injection via next-step, no manual invocation.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a21d3672f1ebb4353ccf.html
